description: Prepare a new Solana coin on AnchorPad, paired with an asset from anchorpad_pairs. Returns a sign link for the user; nothing happens until they approve it in their wallet. The approving wallet becomes the creator and earns 0.4% of every trade in the pair asset. The user pays about 0.027 SOL network rent plus any first buy. Give an image as an https URL (PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, up to 1 MB) if you have one; otherwise the approval page asks the user for it.

first_buy.description: Optional amount of the pair asset to buy in the launch transaction, e.g. "0.1". Default 0

image.description: Optional https URL (or data:image/... URL) of the coin image, up to 1 MB

pair.description: Pair symbol from anchorpad_pairs, e.g. SOL, USDC, ZEC. Default SOL

sniper_shield.description: Higher fee for bots in the first two minutes (10% falling to 1%). Default true

name: anchorpad_prepare_launch
title: Prepare a coin launch
